items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: John Levy, he was a sporting man.

ctx.x: Nobody liked him at all. Think there was five people to his funeral. John Levy, he was a sporting man. Poor John. He had a gin mill right there at 118th and 8th Avenue or 19th, somewhere around there. Poor John. She had a nice guy just before she died, think it was too late then, you know, she got all strung out there you know and it was too late to save her. Had that record against her. Everybody was afraid to hire her.
I guess her reputation followed her around after that time.
